module.purpose: Implements the RowSelection feature for TanStack Table core, providing state shape, options, row/instance methods, and selection propagation logic for selecting rows and subrows.
module.summary: This module defines the RowSelection TableFeature used by the headless table core. It exports types describing selection state, options, and augmented row/instance interfaces. The feature object wires initial state, default options, and table/row factory methods that toggle selections, compute selected row models, and recursively propagate selection to subrows. Helper utilities filter selected rows and evaluate hierarchical selection status.
module.businessContext: Part of a headless UI table library. Enables row selection for data grids, critical for bulk actions. Failure breaks selection UX and data management flows.

detail.name: isSubRowSelected
detail.signature: function isSubRowSelected<TData extends RowData>(selectedRowIds: Record<string, boolean>, id: string, value: boolean, includeChildren: boolean, table: Table<TData>): void
preconditions: id corresponds to a row retrievable via table.getRow(id, true)
table is a valid Table instance with row selection options
postconditions: If value is true and row.getCanSelect() returns true, selectedRowIds[id] is set to true
If value is false, selectedRowIds[id] is deleted
If value is true and row.getCanMultiSelect() is false, all existing keys in selectedRowIds are deleted before setting the new id
If includeChildren and row.subRows exist and row.getCanSelectSubRows() is true, each subRow is recursively mutated with same value and includeChildren
invariants: selectedRowIds is mutated in place, not replaced
Recursion only proceeds when includeChildren is true and subRows present and canSelectSubRows
edgeCases: value false deletes id even if row cannot select
when getCanMultiSelect false, clears all others then sets id if canSelect
no subRows or getCanSelectSubRows false -> no recursion
stateMutations: possibly clears all keys when single-select
detail.summary: Mutates the selectedRowIds map to mark a row (and optionally its sub-rows) as selected or deselected, respecting the row's selection capabilities.
